install_tell: docker run -p 8083:8083 confluentinc/cp-kafka-connect:latest — REST API open by default, no auth block configured
misconfig_patterns: POST /connectors unauthenticated allows arbitrary data-pipeline creation

active_probe.false_positive_check: root JSON body must include kafka_cluster_id field — vendor-unique to Kafka Connect

deployment_tells: GET / self-reports kafka_cluster_id, version, commit unauthenticated
installed connector-plugin classes visible at /connector-plugins (io.debezium.connector.* names confirm CDC use)
pivot_paths: GET /connectors/{name}/config -> source/sink JDBC URLs, S3 keys embedded in connector config
POST /connectors -> create arbitrary exfil sink pointed at attacker infra
connector-plugins enumeration -> fingerprints upstream CDC source systems (Debezium connector class names)
